name: erp-distribuidora
description: Ja'umina ERP — herramientas de nivel de monorepo (backend/ y erp-cocteleria-frontend/ son proyectos npm independientes).

scripts.graph:backend: depcruise backend/src --config .dependency-cruiser.backend.cjs --output-type json > .graph/architecture-map.backend.json && depcruise backend/src --config .dependency-cruiser.backend.cjs --output-type dot > .graph/architecture-map.backend.dot
scripts.graph:frontend: cd erp-cocteleria-frontend && depcruise src --config ../.dependency-cruiser.frontend.cjs --output-type json > ../.graph/architecture-map.frontend.json && depcruise src --config ../.dependency-cruiser.frontend.cjs --output-type dot > ../.graph/architecture-map.frontend.dot
scripts.graph:generate: npm run graph:backend && npm run graph:frontend && node scripts/build-architecture-summary.cjs
